services.name: New Exhibit
services.desc: Check out events at Onyx and around town. Follow us on Instagram @onyxfineartscollective to see move events. The African American Writing Alliance has a wide variety of events happening in the Seattle area. Join them for poetry readings, open mics, writing workshops, and more. All events are free and have an open mic. In "Freedom of Expression”, the Northwest African American Museum partners with Onyx Fine Arts Collective to feature a variety of rotating talented artists. Black art is often pigeonholed as “ethnic”. This exhibit showcases the strength and range of visual expression from artists of African descent living in the Pacific Northwest.
